lines.japanese: 俺が不測の事態に当惑しているうちにも、メイドスタイルの黒い影は早やカウンターを飛びだし、きぃきぃ揺れる抹茶色の扉を駆けぬけてゆきました。
lines.english: Even as I struggled to comprehend the situation, the black, maid-clad shadow shot from behind the counter and raced through the still-squeaking green door.

lines.japanese: うわあ、日和子さんがお転婆してるう。
lines.english: Wow. Hiyoko had gone tearing off after him.

lines.japanese: なんて感心してる場合じゃありません。どれだけ秩序や正義を愛する心意気が男前であろうと、彼女はか弱い体のうら若き乙女。乙女が先を走って、男がぼけっと見送るなんて構図は──
lines.english: This was no time for admiration. However gallant her devotion to order and justice might be, she remained a delicate young woman. To let her charge ahead while the man stood stupidly watching her go would—

lines.japanese: 「──そりゃ世間体が悪いよなあ」
lines.english: “—look terrible, wouldn't it?”

lines.japanese: そんな後ろ向きの勇気を奮いたたせて、俺はきぃきぃ揺れる抹茶色のドアに肩からぶち当たりました。
lines.english: Spurred by that thoroughly backward species of courage, I rammed the squeaking green door with my shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「日和子さん待っ──」
lines.english: “Hiyoko, wai—”

lines.japanese: 「きゃあ！」
lines.english: “Eek!”

lines.japanese: 「うおっ！？」
lines.english: “Whoa!?”

lines.japanese: 往来に一歩踏みだした途端、あの先陣切って飛びだしたはずの勇敢な黒い影が、まるで女の子みたいな悲鳴をあげて俺の背中に回りこんできました。
lines.english: The instant I stepped into the street, the brave black shadow who had supposedly led the charge shrieked like an ordinary girl and darted behind my back.

lines.japanese: 「付いてくんじゃねえ！　し、死なすぞワレェェ！」
lines.english: “Don't follow me! I-I'll fucking kill you!”

lines.japanese: <10>\「えええええっ」
lines.english: “Whaaaaaat?”

lines.japanese: そして一方のお逃げになったお客様（あらため食い逃げクソ野郎）は、テラス席の素敵なチェアーを頭上に掲げ、ぶんぶんぶんと人目も忍ばず振りまわす豪儀っぷり。
lines.english: Meanwhile, our departed customer—henceforth, the dine-and-dash piece of shit—stood with one of the terrace's lovely chairs raised over his head, swinging it wildly without the least concern for who might see him. Magnificent.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっ……えええ、なにいきなり逆ギレしてんのあのひと！」
lines.english: “Wait... What? Why is he suddenly acting like we're the ones in the wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうですよ！　ちゃんとお金払ってください！」
lines.english: “Y-yes! Pay what you owe!”

lines.japanese: ああっ、俺の後ろで怯えながら虚勢を張っている日和子さんがちょっぴり可愛い！
lines.english: Ah! Hiyoko was putting on a brave face while trembling behind me, and it was just a little adorable!

lines.japanese: 「うるせえェェェ！」
lines.english: “Shut the hell up!”

lines.japanese: でも、むやみに相手を刺激しないで日和子さん！
lines.english: Don't provoke him, Hiyoko!

lines.japanese: 「ち、千歳さん、早くお代をいただいてきてください」
lines.english: “Ch-Chitose, hurry and collect the money from him.”

lines.japanese: 「お、俺っ？」
lines.english: “M-me?”

lines.japanese: 「そのために来てくれたんじゃないんですか！？」
lines.english: “Isn't that why you followed me out here!?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、まあ、そうなんですけど……」
lines.english: “Well, yes, I suppose it was...”

lines.japanese: っても、まさか相手があんなバイオレンスモードだとは思わなかったしなあ。改めて見ると向こうさん、背高いし声でかいし、物理的にも威圧感たっぷりだもん。
lines.english: Still, I had hardly expected the man to turn violent. Looking at him now, he was tall, loud, and physically intimidating in every respect.

lines.japanese: 「ぶっちゃけた話、肉弾戦ってあんまり俺の領分じゃないんすよねえ」
lines.english: “To be perfectly honest, hand-to-hand combat isn't really my area.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はあっ？」
lines.english: “I-I beg your pardon?”

lines.japanese: 「冗談です」
lines.english: “Just kidding.”

lines.japanese: 本当はわりと冗談じゃないんだけど、ねえ、そんな悲しくなるほど呆れられちゃったら……はあ、行くしかないですよね。
lines.english: It wasn't entirely a joke. But when she looked at me with such crushing, almost sorrowful disbelief... Well. What choice did I have but to go?

lines.japanese: 「まあ、日和子さんのピンチは俺が助けるって約束しましたしね」
lines.english: “Besides, I promised I'd save you whenever you were in trouble.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: こんな塀など愛の翼で飛びこえました、だっけ？　ロミオとジュリエット。読んだことないけど。
lines.english: ‘With love's light wings did I o'erperch these walls’—was that it? *Romeo and Juliet*. Never read it.

lines.japanese: 「危ないから。下がってて」
lines.english: “It's dangerous. Stay back.”

lines.japanese: 体を掴む頼りない指をほどいて、俺は前へ進みでました。
lines.english: I gently pried away the uncertain fingers clutching my clothes and stepped forward.

lines.japanese: 「えーっと……こんな感じだっけえ？」
lines.english: “Um... Was it something like this?”

lines.japanese: 後ろ頭をがしがし掻いて、舌先で頬の裏側を突付いて、いよっと、どっかのボクサー崩れがするようにこぶしをふたつ視線の先に置いてみます。
lines.english: I scratched hard at the back of my head, prodded the inside of my cheek with my tongue, then—hup—raised both fists before my eyes like some third-rate boxer.

lines.japanese: だいたいこんなだよね、ファイティング・ポーズって……ああ、しっかり脇を締めるんだっけコノヤロウ。
lines.english: This was more or less what a fighting stance looked like, wasn't it? Oh, right. Elbows tucked in, you bastard.

lines.japanese: 「あのー、お客さん？　べつに警察に届けたりしませんのでー、今日のところはお互い穏便に、ね？　代金だけ置いてっていただけませんかねえ」
lines.english: “Excuse me, sir? We won't report this to the police, so why don't we keep things peaceful today, hmm? Could you simply leave the money you owe and be on your way?”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんじゃねえ！　なにが狙いだてめえ！」
lines.english: “Don't screw with me! What the hell are you after?”

lines.japanese: 野暮な悪役レスラーさながら、上段に椅子を構えて叫ぶ食い逃げ犯。
lines.english: Our dine-and-dasher roared with the chair raised high, every inch the tacky wrestling villain.

lines.japanese: 「いや、狙いってそんな人聞きの悪い……」
lines.english: “After? That makes me sound awfully sinister...”

lines.japanese: 「そんなに……そんなに俺が気に喰わねえなら……」
lines.english: “If... If you hate me that much...”

lines.japanese: 「オメーから潰してやる！」
lines.english: “I'll smash you first!”
“What?”

lines.japanese: <8>\「ぬあああぁぁぁっ！！」
lines.english: “Nwaaaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「千歳さん！」
lines.english: “Chitose!”

lines.japanese: 「え？　え？　えええっ！？」
lines.english: “What? What? Whaaaaat!?”

lines.japanese: 長身の男が喉の奥から雄叫びを迸らせ、前のめりに身を倒しながら無骨な武器を振りおろしました。
lines.english: The tall man loosed a roar from deep in his throat, pitched himself forward, and brought his crude weapon crashing down.

lines.japanese: 「ひいいっ！」
lines.english: “Eeeeeek!”

lines.japanese: 恐れおののいた俺はでたらめに頭をかばいながら、ばたたたたと小刻みに後ずさりました。ファイティング・ポーズ？　ししし、知らないよそんなの！
lines.english: Stricken with terror, I threw my arms over my head and pattered backward in a flurry of tiny steps. Fighting stance? I-I-I had never heard of such a thing!

lines.japanese: ばきっ！
lines.english: Crack!

lines.japanese: 慌てて引いた靴の先で水色の突風がうなり、意外に甲高い衝撃音が弾けました。
lines.english: A pale-blue gale howled past the toe of my retreating shoe, followed by a surprisingly sharp crack.

lines.japanese: ウッドフレームの青い椅子は、コンクリートタイルに遠慮のない力で叩きつけられ、背もたれの根元でばっくり折れまがりました。
lines.english: The blue chair's wooden frame struck the concrete tiles with merciless force and split wide open where its back joined the seat.

lines.japanese: 痛々しい裂け目が覗いていっそう凶器めいたそれは、男の手の下でゆらりと揺れていました。
lines.english: The painful-looking break only made it resemble a weapon more. It swayed beneath the man's hand.

lines.japanese: 「なっ……なに、暴力！？　それ暴力！？」
lines.english: “Wh-what was that? Violence!? Was that violence!?”

lines.japanese: 「貴様ァ……」
男は帽子の下から血走った目で俺を睨み、折れまがった椅子を腰の後ろへ回しました。それから、ろくに狙いも定めずにサイドスローで──
lines.english: Bloodshot eyes glared at me from beneath his hat. He drew the broken chair behind his waist, then flung it sidearm without anything resembling proper aim—

lines.japanese: <8>\「よけるなァァァ！」
lines.english: “Stop dodging!”

lines.japanese: ──投げとばしてきた！
lines.english: —and sent it flying!

lines.japanese: 「きゃあああっ！！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: しまった！　その砲弾はやつの意図とは裏腹に、俺の横にいた日和子さんの頭へ向かって突きすすむ──
lines.english: Damn it! Contrary to his intentions, the projectile was hurtling straight toward Hiyoko's head beside me—
